seeds.name: stale version string
seeds.description: Replaces a version literal with the stale string 9.9.9

seeds.name: dropped return value
seeds.description: Drops the value from a return so the caller gets nothing

seeds.name: inverted comparison
seeds.description: Flips a comparison operator to its opposite

seeds.name: off by one constant
seeds.description: Adds one to an integer constant in a return or comparison

seeds.name: swallowed exception
seeds.description: Replaces an exception handler body with a silent pass

seeds.name: inverted boolean literal
seeds.description: Flips a boolean literal to its opposite

seeds.name: swapped arithmetic operator
seeds.description: Swaps an arithmetic operator for a different one

seeds.name: dropped call argument
seeds.description: Drops the last argument from a call that takes at least two

seeds.name: negated condition
seeds.description: Wraps an if condition in a negation

seeds.name: removed collection element
seeds.description: Removes the first element from a list or dictionary literal

seeds.name: range bound shifted by one
seeds.description: Raises the last bound of a range call by one

seeds.name: wrong variable returned
seeds.description: Returns the next parameter instead of the one the code named

seeds.name: swapped operand order
seeds.description: Swaps the operands of a subtraction, division, floor division, or modulo, where the order of the operands decides the result

seeds.name: dropped else branch
seeds.description: Drops the else branch of a conditional so the fallback path never runs

seeds.name: swapped boolean operator
seeds.description: Swaps a boolean and for an or, or an or for an and, in a compound condition

seeds.name: dropped await
seeds.description: Removes an await so the caller holds a coroutine instead of the awaited result

seeds.name: widened exception handler
seeds.description: Widens an exception handler so it catches the broad base error type

seeds.name: swapped dictionary entry
seeds.description: Swaps the key and the value of a dictionary entry so the mapping answers backwards

seeds.name: inverted truth test
seeds.description: Toggles the negation on a condition test so its sense reads backwards on the shapes no other seed plants

seeds.name: reassigned loop variable
seeds.description: Points a for loop at a different name already bound in the same scope so the loop writes into the wrong variable

seeds.name: swapped call argument order
seeds.description: Swaps the first two positional arguments of a call so each value reaches the wrong parameter

seeds.name: altered string literal
seeds.description: Changes the first character of a string literal so the text the code compares or returns is no longer the text it wrote

seeds.name: dropped numeric negation
seeds.description: Removes a unary minus so a value carries the opposite sign from the one the code wrote

seeds.name: swapped loop control
seeds.description: Turns a break inside a loop into a continue so the loop runs on instead of ending

seeds.name: swapped augmented assignment operator
seeds.description: Swaps the operator of an augmented assignment so the value it accumulates moves the wrong way

seeds.name: identity test replaced by equality
seeds.description: Replaces an identity comparison with an equality comparison so the test asks sameness of value instead of sameness of object

seeds.name: subscript index shifted by one
seeds.description: Raises the constant index of a subscript by one so the code reads the element beside the one it named

seeds.name: swapped keyword argument values
seeds.description: Swaps the values of the first two keyword arguments of a call so each value binds to the wrong parameter

seeds.name: swapped raised error
seeds.description: Swaps the exception type a raise throws for the first other exception type the module names so the error a caller handles is never the one that arrives

seeds.name: slice stop shifted by one
seeds.description: Raises the stop of a slice by one so the code takes one element more than the slice it wrote

seeds.name: shifted numeric default
seeds.description: Raises a numeric argument default by one so a call that leaves the argument out runs with a value the code never wrote

seeds.name: swapped sibling attribute
seeds.description: Reads the second attribute a scope loads off one object in place of the first so the value comes from a different part of the object than the code named

seeds.name: narrowed exception handler
seeds.description: Narrows an exception handler that names the broad base error type to the first specific error type its try body raises so the other failures the handler was written to recover from escape past it

seeds.name: swapped parameter defaults
seeds.description: Exchanges the first two argument defaults of a definition so each parameter falls back to the value the code wrote for the other

seeds.name: dropped finally body
seeds.description: Drops the finally block of a try statement so the cleanup the code wrote to run on every path never runs

seeds.name: dropped decorator
seeds.description: Removes the first decorator from a definition so the behaviour the decorator added never runs

seeds.name: dropped exception handler
seeds.description: Removes the first exception handler of a try statement so the failure it was written to recover from reaches a later handler instead, or escapes to the caller where no handler stands after it

seeds.name: dropped yield
seeds.description: Replaces each yield with the value it yields so the function runs as an ordinary function and produces none of the items it was written to generate

seeds.name: dropped condition term
seeds.description: Drops the last term of a compound condition so the cases that term admitted or rejected are decided by the terms that stay

seeds.name: dropped base class
seeds.description: Removes the first base class of a class definition so the behaviour the class inherited from that base is not there

seeds.name: shifted slice start
seeds.description: Raises the start of a slice by one so the code takes its elements from one position later than the slice it wrote

seeds.name: reversed loop control
seeds.description: Turns a continue inside a loop into a break so the loop ends at the first item it was written to skip and every later item goes unprocessed

seeds.name: dropped scope declaration
seeds.description: Removes a global or nonlocal declaration so a plain assignment meant for the module or the enclosing scope lands in a local and is lost silently, and an augmented assignment reads that local first and raises instead

seeds.name: swapped assignment values
seeds.description: Exchanges the first two elements of the tuple an assignment binds so each name takes the value the code wrote for the other

seeds.name: dropped loop else clause
seeds.description: Drops the else clause of a loop so the code written to run when the loop finishes without a break never runs

seeds.name: dropped keyword argument
seeds.description: Drops the first keyword argument of a call so the callee never receives the value the caller named for that parameter

seeds.name: flipped range step sign
seeds.description: Negates the step of a range call carrying three arguments so the sequence travels in the opposite direction from the one the code wrote

seeds.name: dropped logical negation
seeds.description: Removes a logical not standing outside a condition test so the expression it negated carries the opposite truth from the one the code wrote
